datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Malawi in 2011. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (food insecurity severity levels) under different scenarios, with data compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for medium-term projections.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity levels across geographic areas.
